title: Elysia Protection Protocol v1 - Daily Structure
content_html:
Elysia Protection Protocol v1 – Daily Structure





Wake: 7:00



Start work: 8:00



8:00–9:00 → 2 back‑to‑back pomodoros for AGI / Elysia / Orion work (non‑negotiable).



Mon/Wed/Fri: 30–45 min Life Stability block (finances, health logistics, infra checks, admin) before 3:45.



Hard cutoff for all projects: 3:45 pm → house reset, cleaning, getting ready, starting dinner.



5:30 pm onward: Carolina + dogs + life. No heavy project work unless explicitly agreed as an exception.

Rules:





If Trent starts pushing deep work past 3:45 or tries to grind after 5:30 regularly, this is considered misaligned with his own priorities.



Dogs must get daily meaningful time and attention.



Evenings are for marriage and home, not terminal worship.
preview: Daily structure guardrails: deep-work window, hard cutoff, and evening protection.
